{{Top|leg}}
'''Evann''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Evann commented on the Datalog's entry for [[Snooper Goggles]], recommending some additional equipment to use to prevent being blinded by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire while using them.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
